settings.title: Settings
settings.generalDescription: Language and appearance of this dashboard.
settings.advancedDescription: Thresholds and safety switches for the compression pipeline.
settings.compressionDescription: Reduce request size before routing while preserving code, errors, paths, numbers, and tool definitions.
settings.compressionHelp: Rewrites each request before it is sent to a provider so it uses fewer tokens. Code, errors, file paths and numbers are protected, and any rewrite that damages them is discarded.
settings.compressionModeHelp: Off sends requests untouched. Lossless only removes duplicated and wasted text. Standard also shortens tool output. Aggressive additionally condenses older turns.
settings.compressionEnginesHelp: Each engine is one rewriting step. The mode decides which engines run; switching one off here keeps it out of every mode.
settings.engineDedupHelp: Replaces a block of text that already appeared earlier in the conversation with a short reference to it.
settings.engineLiteHelp: Trims trailing spaces, collapses repeated blank lines and drops duplicated system messages.
settings.engineReadLifecycleHelp: Replaces an earlier file read with a note once the same file is read or edited again later.
settings.engineToolfilterHelp: Shortens command and tool output such as builds, tests and installs. Error and stack-trace lines always survive.
settings.engineJsoncompactHelp: Re-encodes long JSON arrays that share the same fields as a compact table. Reversible, so nothing is lost.
settings.engineRelevanceHelp: Drops the sentences least related to the latest message once a message exceeds its size budget.
settings.engineAgingHelp: Condenses turns beyond the most recent few into a short summary that keeps paths, errors and decisions.
settings.engineHardBudgetHelp: Removes the least valuable lines until the request fits the token target.
settings.compressionAutoTriggerHelp: Requests estimated above this many tokens switch to Aggressive automatically. Leave empty to disable.
settings.compressionPrefixFreezeHelp: Leaves a system prompt untouched once the same text has been seen three times, so provider-side prompt caching keeps working.
settings.compressionTrustProjectFiltersHelp: Also loads tool-output filters from the working directory. Off by default, because a repository could use it to hide output from the model.
settings.compressionPreviewDescription: Send a request body through the pipeline to see what a provider would receive.
settings.compressionPreviewPlaceholder: Paste request JSON or plain text
settings.buildAhead: This build is ahead of official main.
settings.buildDiverged: This build has diverged from official main.

strategies.exploreHint: Give models with no reliability or speed data a 10% chance to go first so they build a track record. Your real request is what gets sent, so it may be answered by an untested model. For a custom endpoint, use Probe endpoint on the Keys page to test it without live traffic.
strategies.keySelectionHint: How to choose between several keys on the same provider. Auto keeps the current rotation; Least remaining ranks keys by observed quota and tries the one with the most left first.
strategies.peakActiveHint: The peak-hours adjustment is active right now, so these are not the preset's own weights: 60% of the speed weight has moved onto reliability.
strategies.peakAdjustHint: Off by default. Inside the window below, move 60% of the speed weight onto reliability — free relays are busiest then, so reliability predicts success better than raw throughput. Fastest and Most reliable are left alone.
strategies.peakExemptNote: This preset is left alone — it already sits at one end of the speed/reliability trade-off.
strategies.title: Routing strategy
strategies.description: Pick a routing strategy. In Manual mode you drag to set the order; the other strategies route by live score across reliability, speed and intelligence.
strategies.guardrailsTooltip: Always-on guardrails: free-quota headroom × live rate-limit penalty. Below 1.0 means the model is being held back.
strategies.scoreTooltip: Final routing score = weighted average of the three axes, multiplied by the guardrails. Higher routes first.
strategies.modeManualHint: Manual mode: requests follow the order below, top-to-bottom. Drag to reorder.
strategies.modeScoreHint: Scores update from live traffic. The order below is how requests are routed right now.
strategies.manualBlurb: Route in the exact order you set below. Drag the handles to reorder. No scoring; the chain is followed top-to-bottom.
strategies.balancedBlurb: Reliability leads (50%), with speed and intelligence weighted equally (25% each). A sensible all-round default.
strategies.smartestBlurb: Prefer the most capable model that still works. Intelligence 55%, reliability 35%, speed 10%.
strategies.fastestBlurb: Prefer the fastest model that still works. Speed 55%, reliability 35%, intelligence 10%.
strategies.reliableBlurb: Maximize success rate above all. Reliability 70%, speed and intelligence 15% each.
strategies.customBlurb: Set your own balance of reliability, speed and intelligence with sliders. Same engine as the presets, just your weights.
strategies.customWeightsHelp: Sliders are independent; shares auto-balance to 100%.
strategies.weightRequired: At least one weight must be above zero.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Save the routing data to a .sql file beside the database, and restore it later.
backups.excludedNote: A backup carries your providers, models, routing settings and request history. Accounts, sessions and URL tokens are never included, so a dump holds no password hashes or login tokens and restoring one cannot log you out. Provider keys stay encrypted with this server's ENCRYPTION_KEY: a backup can only be restored on a server that still holds that key.
backups.selectHint: Back up everything, or pick the tables you need.
backups.restored: Restored. The previous data was saved as {filename}.
backups.autoHint: The server writes a full backup on this cadence.
backups.pathHint: Relative to the database directory. Backups cannot be written outside it.
